approvers: Main contractor / developer who sets protection in the subcontract package
reason: Our aluminium already arrives with factory film, and what protection we provide is set by the main contractor in the subcontract package, not by me. A new budget line and a new supplier for a sprayed coating is not something I would take on.
objection: I would not put a sprayed coating on coated glass and finished frames without compatibility proof. If it marks the frames or leaves residue, I carry the claim, and the film we already use does the job.
instead: Keep using the factory film and the protection the main contractor specifies in the package, plus our own care on site.
would_change_my_mind: A main contractor or developer writing it into the subcontract package and paying for it, plus written compatibility results on our coated glass and frames from a named reference job.
